name: Value Plus Auto Parts Wholesale
old_description: A Trusted Wholesale Auto Parts Supplier Serving Southeast Michigan Since 1997
about:
Value Plus Auto Parts Wholesale operates from two locations in the Detroit metro area — Westland and Detroit, Michigan — and has served Southeast Michigan since its founding in 1997. The business was established as a wholesale auto parts supplier focused on repair facilities, commercial auto businesses, and retail customers, building a reputation for dependable service and competitive pricing over more than two decades.

The company distributes a broad range of automotive components including brake parts, ignition components, engine parts, cooling system parts, suspension parts, filters, electrical components, and motor oil for both domestic and import vehicles. Its inventory is organized in good, better, and best tiers, and it supports customers with fast delivery, stocking accounts, online ordering tools, delivery tracking, and the APA PRO Auto Care nationwide warranty program.

Primary customers are independent repair shops, commercial fleet operators, and retail motorists throughout Southeast Michigan. The supplier also works with independent mechanics and automotive service centers that rely on quick access to quality parts from brands such as Bosch, Denso, Dorman, AC Delco, Timken, TRW, and Hitachi.

Value Plus differentiates itself through a mission to provide quality parts at the most competitive prices by leveraging a network of small businesses that negotiate collectively with vendors. Its promise emphasizes availability, service programs for both retail and repair facilities, and a commitment to longevity through prosperity, backed by knowledgeable staff and a professional, organized operation.
